checks.text: The page heading is "Roman Numeral Converter".
Typing 4 in the field labelled "Number" shows "IV" in the field labelled "Roman numeral".
Typing 1994 in the field labelled "Number" shows "MCMXCIV" in the field labelled "Roman numeral".
Typing 3999 in the field labelled "Number" shows "MMMCMXCIX" in the field labelled "Roman numeral".
Typing 0 in the field labelled "Number" shows the message "Enter an integer from 1 to 3999" and the field labelled "Roman numeral" is empty.
Clicking the button "Copy" after converting 2024 places "MMXXIV" on the clipboard.
Clicking the tab "History" shows a list containing the most recent conversion "2024 → MMXXIV".
Clicking the button "Clear history" on the History tab removes all items and shows the text "No history yet".
Reload keeps the history entry "2024 → MMXXIV" visible on the History tab.
